msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you have referral paperwork and e-learning completed, the *Open Water Referral Course* is the right option, provided your referral paperwork is signed by a PADI instructor.

The refresher is a separate one-day activity, so you’d do it the day before the referral course. These are the online prices, which include the 10% online discount.

The referral course requires an overnight stay on the islands, which isn’t included. Please allow at least *18 hours after the referral dives before flying*.

The referred course requires a PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; it is the “Open Water Referral Course,” not a regular dive trip.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

After more than 2 years without diving, a refresher is normally needed before the trip; if you’ve already completed a refresher or PADI ReActivate at another center, that counts as your refresher.
